test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 12th Sep 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Convert the sentence provided below from its passive voice structure to an active voice structure:**

Lunch is delivered to the office every morning.

options.text: The office delivers the lunch every morning.
Someone delivers the lunch to the office every morning.
The office has delivered the lunch every morning.
The lunch delivers itself to the office every morning.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the passive sentence provided: "Lunch is delivered to the office every morning."
 
• To convert to active voice: Identify the implied subject "someone" who performs the action.
 
• Reconstruct the sentence: "Someone delivers the lunch to the office every morning."
 
• Ensure the tense and meaning remain consistent during the conversion.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Someone delivers the lunch to the office every morning."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The office delivers the lunch every morning." – Incorrect subject (the office cannot deliver lunch).
 
• **Option 3: **"The office has delivered the lunch every morning." – Incorrect tense and subject.
 
• **Option 4: **"The lunch delivers itself to the office every morning." – Illogical and incorrect.
